body.name: Operational acceptance \(\operatorname{Acc}(Q,E;G)\)
body.construction: Parse the finite structural string \(x_{\mathrm{str}}\) before reading the supplied finite certificate string \(E\). Parse \(E\) into the fixed-width masks and self-delimiting transcripts of the uniform-record definition. Return \(0\) for malformed input, malformed certificate length or identifier, repeated record, nonpartition of \([k]\), illegal protocol, inconsistent or out-of-catalogue label, oracle reply \(\bot\), malformed oracle support index, undefined event \(H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\), zero support for that event, source mask not extracted from the returned law handle, failed measured-ancestry typing, or invalid restriction step. Otherwise cache the oracle reply for each distinct protocol, construct the entire deduplicated source collection \(\mathcal R(E)\), normalize \(Q\), and execute complete unconditional CTFIDU\({}^{+}\) from the first ancestral-set transformation through factorization and exhaustive search over every decoded source. Return \(1\) exactly when the complete run does not return \(\operatorname{FAIL}\), every \(C_j\) is owned exactly once, and each claimed protocol, slice, source, and transcript schema reproduces a successful IDENTIFY\({}^{+}\) branch for every assignment and induced equality type in \(\Omega_j\). Return \(0\) otherwise. Every source-law or support access is an explicit \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}\) query charged to \(N_{\mathcal O}\); \(\operatorname{Reg}\) contains no hidden law or positivity test.
